title: Grok Imagine Creator Input Schema
description: Input specification for generating optimized prompts for the Grok Imagine API — supports text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and upscale modes

mode.title: 1. Generation Mode
mode.description: Generation type: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, or upscale

enumDescriptions.text-to-image: Generate image(s) from text description only
enumDescriptions.image-to-image: Transform a reference image based on text instructions
enumDescriptions.text-to-video: Generate video from text description only
enumDescriptions.image-to-video: Animate a reference image into a video
enumDescriptions.upscale: Enhance resolution of a previously generated video (360p to 720p) — pipeline step only

description.title: 2. Creative Brief
description.description: Main creative brief describing what to generate. For video upscale pipeline, describe what to preserve and enhancement preferences.
examples: A serene Japanese garden at sunset with cherry blossoms falling gently
Transform this photo into an anime-style illustration
A Thai street food vendor cooking pad thai at night market with neon lights
Animate this portrait — the character slowly turns and smiles at camera
Generate a cinematic video of a drone flyover and upscale to 720p

enumDescriptions.th: Thai — Thai with technical terms in English

style.title: 4. Visual Style
style.description: Visual style preset that determines lighting, color, and overall aesthetic

enumDescriptions.cinematic: Film-like quality, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field
enumDescriptions.anime: Japanese animation style, cel-shaded, vibrant colors
enumDescriptions.cartoon: Western cartoon style, bold outlines, exaggerated features
enumDescriptions.noir: High contrast, shadows, moody black-and-white feel
enumDescriptions.vintage: Retro film grain, muted tones, period-appropriate look

aspectRatio.title: 5. Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Output aspect ratio — affects composition and framing

grokMode.title: 6. Grok Mode
grokMode.description: Grok content generation mode. Spicy is only available for text-to-video without image inputs. Fun is available for all modes.

enumDescriptions.fun: More creative, playful, exaggerated results (all modes)
enumDescriptions.spicy: Edgier, bolder creative choices (text-to-video only, no image inputs)

duration.title: 7. Video Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Video length in seconds. Only 6, 10, or 15 are supported by Grok Imagine. Video modes only.

enumDescriptions.6: 6 seconds — Quick clip, one clear action
enumDescriptions.15: 15 seconds — Mini narrative with beginning, middle, and end

cameraMovement.title: 9. Camera Movement
cameraMovement.description: Camera motion style. Video modes only.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on content and style
enumDescriptions.tilt: Tilt up/down — vertical sweep, reveal height
enumDescriptions.dolly: Dolly in/out — move closer or farther

shotType.title: 10. Shot Type
shotType.description: Shot framing type — camera distance from subject

enumDescriptions.wide: Wide shot — full body, environment context
enumDescriptions.extreme_close_up: Extreme close-up — eyes, small details, macro

characters.title: 11. Character Descriptions
characters.description: Character descriptions, one per line in format: Name: visual description
examples: Mia: Young Thai woman, long black hair, white linen shirt, warm smile

Ana: Young woman, long black hair, blue dress, cheerful
Bob: Tall man, short brown hair, suit, serious

characterConsistency.title: 12. Character Consistency
characterConsistency.description: Include character sheet in prompt for visual consistency across generations

reference_images.title: 13. Reference Images
reference_images.description: Reference image URLs for image-to-image or image-to-video modes. Not used for upscale (upscale uses internal task_id from pipeline).

referenceNotes.title: 14. Reference Notes
referenceNotes.description: Instructions on how to use reference images — what to keep, what to change
examples: Keep the background but change the character's outfit to red
Maintain the pose and expression, change the lighting to golden hour

negativeElements.title: 15. Elements to Avoid
negativeElements.description: Elements to avoid in the generation. Describe what IS wanted rather than what isn't when possible.
examples: blurry, low quality, watermark, text overlay, distorted faces

numberOfVariations.title: 16. Number of Variations
numberOfVariations.description: Number of prompt variations to generate with different approaches

lighting.title: 17. Lighting Style
lighting.description: Lighting style preference for the scene

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on style and mood

colorPalette.title: 18. Color Palette
colorPalette.description: Color mood preference — affects overall tone and feel

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on style and mood
enumDescriptions.warm: Warm amber and orange tones — cozy, inviting
enumDescriptions.cool: Cool blue and gray tones — professional, clean
enumDescriptions.pastel: Soft pastel tones — dreamy, gentle, romantic
enumDescriptions.monochrome: Black and white or near-monochrome — artistic
enumDescriptions.teal_orange: Teal shadows + orange highlights — cinematic blockbuster
enumDescriptions.earthy: Greens, browns, warm neutrals — organic, nature
enumDescriptions.neon_cyberpunk: Neon pink, cyan, purple — futuristic, nightlife
enumDescriptions.vintage_film: Faded highlights, lifted blacks, film grain — retro

mood.title: 19. Mood / Atmosphere
mood.description: Overall emotional tone of the scene

enumDescriptions.futuristic: Blue/cyan tones, clean lines, tech aesthetic

pipeline.title: 20. Pipeline Execution Depth
pipeline.description: Controls how far the system should execute: prompt only, prompt + generate, or prompt + generate + upscale (video only). Upscale pipeline is available for text-to-video and image-to-video modes only.

enumDescriptions.prompt_only: Generate optimized prompt only — no media generation
enumDescriptions.prompt_and_generate: Generate prompt and automatically create the media (image or video)
enumDescriptions.prompt_generate_upscale: Generate prompt, create video, then upscale 360p→720p (video modes only)

examples.description: A serene Japanese garden at sunset with cherry blossoms falling gently onto a koi pond
A street food vendor in Bangkok cooking pad thai at a night market, neon signs reflecting on wet pavement
Transform this photo into a Studio Ghibli anime style with soft watercolor backgrounds
examples.referenceNotes: Keep the composition and character pose, change art style to anime

examples.description: The character slowly turns to face the camera and smiles warmly
examples.characters: Mia: Young Thai woman, long black hair, white linen shirt

examples.description: A Thai street food chef flipping pad thai in a wok with flames, neon night market behind
